are_you_ok.title: Minnesota hits 100 degrees for first time since 2022
are_you_ok.summary: MN hits 100 for first time since 2022 — big just-happened heat event affecting the metro. Are-you-ok.
are_you_ok.description: According to the National Weather Service, parts of Minnesota hit 100 degrees air temperature on Monday. Officials say it’s the first time the state has had a high temperature in the triple digits in more than four years.
